+def test_transfer_returns_the_eur_source_balance(bank):
+    client = login(bank["app"], bank["owner"])
+    response = transfer(client, bank["eur"].id, bank["foreign"].number, "25.00")
+    assert response.status_code == 201
+    assert response.json().get("source_balance_minor") == 7500
+
+
+def test_transfer_returns_the_jpy_source_balance(bank):
+    conn = ledger.open_db(bank["path"])
+    target = ledger.open_account(conn, bank["other"], "JPY")
+    conn.close()
+    client = login(bank["app"], bank["owner"])
+    response = transfer(client, bank["jpy"].id, target.number, "500")
+    assert response.status_code == 201
+    assert response.json().get("source_balance_minor") == 4500
+
